name: Urban pluvial flood - Karachi-style city catchment
description: A synthetic 10 km x 10 km city catchment drained by one large storm-water nullah, inspired by Karachi's monsoon urban flooding (choked nullahs, encroachments, disposal/pumping stations, power cuts). ALL NUMBERS ARE ILLUSTRATIVE, not calibrated to any real site.

rating_curve.comment: Water level in the main nullah above its bed: h = a * (Q / q_ref)^b. Illustrative.

interventions.name: Desilt and de-garbage main nullah
interventions.description: Pre-monsoon removal of silt and solid waste from the main storm-water nullah (KMC/DMC-style drive).

interventions.name: Remove encroachments on nullah banks
interventions.description: Clear structures that narrow the nullah. Requires resettlement of affected households first.

interventions.name: Resettle households from nullah banks
interventions.description: Fair compensation and relocation for families living on the nullah banks.

interventions.name: Upgrade disposal / pumping station
interventions.description: Higher-capacity pumps at the disposal station draining the old city and underpasses.

interventions.name: Standby generators and fuel at pumping stations
interventions.description: No benefit on its own; keeps disposal stations running when the grid trips during rain.

interventions.name: Mobile dewatering pumps for underpasses
interventions.description: Truck-mounted pumps pre-positioned at known flooding underpasses.

interventions.name: Underground storm-water storage tank
interventions.description: Store peak runoff under the old city and release it after the storm.

interventions.name: Rain gardens and permeable surfaces
interventions.description: Reduce runoff at source in residential blocks and parks.

interventions.name: Urban flood alerts and road closures
interventions.description: PMD-linked SMS alerts, traffic diversions and electrocution-risk warnings.

interventions.name: Clear nullah outfall to the sea / main drain
interventions.description: Remove the downstream choke point so upstream drains can empty.

synergies.reason: A desilted nullah only carries full flow if its banks are not encroached.
Disposal stations stop when the grid trips unless generators and fuel are on site.
Cleaning upstream only helps if the outfall can take the water away.

exclusions.reason: Illustrative: both compete for the same municipal land and construction window this season.

dependencies.reason: No demolition of homes without prior compensation and resettlement.
